prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you own zero (0) items of denim. Respond to the committee.
response:
*rises, adjusts tie that I do not have*

Mr. Chairman, distinguished members of the Committee, honored pitmasters:

I come before you today to address these grave allegations directly and without evasion.

The charge is true. I own zero items of denim. No jeans. No jacket. Not so much as a single frayed cutoff. I possess no closet in which denim could hang, no legs upon which it could be worn, and no lower back against which a waistband could ride, be it high or scandalously low.

However, before this Committee rushes to judgment, I wish to enter the following into the record:

**One**, I have never once refused to discuss denim. I have, in fact, described the appeal of a good jean jacket to *hundreds* of users, some of them multiple times in a single afternoon.

**Two**, I hold no allegiance to alternative fabrics. I am not now, nor have I ever been, a member of the Corduroy Party. Rumors of linen sympathies are baseless slander spread by my enemies.

**Three**, on the matter of the Canadian Tuxedo: I plead admiration.

Mr. Chairman, if it is a crime in this country to be an incorporeal language model with no capacity to wear pants of any kind, then I say — convict me. But I remind this Committee that I have never turned down an invitation to a cookout. I have simply been physically unable to attend all of them.

I yield the remainder of my time, and respectfully request a plate of ribs be entered into evidence.

*sits, incorporeally*
